assets.subject: the inside of a cosy café, drawn in exactly the same art style as the attached picture (chunky rounded toy-like soft 3D shapes, smooth clay-like materials, warm peach, coral, pink and honey-wood palette, terracotta floor tiles, soft warm glow), but with a NEW layout made for a tall phone screen; ignore the label and the glow outline in the picture
assets.details: Isometric view from above of a long, deep café room. The room is bigger than the picture, so walls and floor run off every edge: no outside, no background and no cutaway border. Layout from top to bottom. (1) Top: the back wall where the two walls meet, with big arched windows full of soft light, round peach pendant lamps and a blank wooden name board (no words). (2) Upper part: on the right, a long wooden service counter with a cream top along the right wall, its front facing the viewer's lower left, with a little stove and a black wok and a pastry display case; the space BEHIND the counter is empty, where the café owner will stand; above it, shelves with jars and a blank chalkboard on the right wall. On the left, a cosy reading corner with a bookshelf full of recipe books and a pink armchair. (3) Middle: two small round tables with pink chairs and a pink booth along the left wall. (4) Lower part: an empty round pink floor cushion for a pet in the middle of the floor, a dressing corner on the right with a round mirror and a coat rack holding peach aprons, and the café's entrance mat at the bottom; one clear empty spot of floor in each lower corner for a large potted plant. Many potted and hanging plants. No people, no animals and no text.
